content.text: Pi’in balyang e ma lungurad u lanin’rad,
“Dariy e Got!”
Yad gubin nrib gel e kireb rorad,
ka ra ngongliyed bogi ban’en nrib gel e kireb riy;
dariy ta’abe’ ni be rin’ e tin bfel’.
I SOMOL e be changar ngak e girdi’ u tharmiy nga but’
ni nge guy ko bay bochi yad nib gonop,
ni yad be meybil ma yad be liyor ngak Got fa dariy.
Machane yad gubin ni karanod nga wuru’ e wo’,
yad gubin ni ta’reb rogorad ni yad ba kireb;
dariy ta’a bagayad ni bfel’,
nta’a bagayad ma dariy.
Me fith SOMOL ni ga’ar, “Gur dar nanged?
Gur urngin e pi cha’ney ni yad be ngongliy e kireb e de tamilangan’rad?
Kar pired yad be leag u fithik’ e yargel e tirok e girdi’ rog,
ma darir meybilgad ngog.”
Machane bay ra m’ad ko marus,
ya Got e be par rok e pi’in yad be folwok rok.
Girdi’ ni kireb e yad ma gathay e puruy’ rok e pi’in gafgow,
machane SOMOL e ir e yoror rorad.
Ri gu be meybil
nu Zion e nge yib e ayuw riy ngak yu Israel!
Rib gel e felfelan’ nra tay e girdi’ nu Israel
nap’an nra fal’eg SOMOL rograd bayay!
